_comment: Extra Bluetooth keys. Edit and the server picks changes up automatically (no firmware reflash). page: keyboard (usage 1-0xF1) or consumer (usage 1-0x3FF). group 'extra' shows the key in the TV controls grid; Common consumer usages: Home 0x223, Menu 0x40, Volume Up 0xE9, Volume Down 0xEA, Mute 0xE2, Play/Pause 0xCD, Record 0xB2, Power 0x30, Next 0xB5, Previous 0xB6.
